sloka: व्यसने वा अर्थ कृच्छ्रे वा भये वा जीवितान्तगे ।विमृशन् वै स्वया बुद्ध्या धृतिमान् न अवसीदति ॥४-७-९॥
transliteration: vyasane vā artha kṛcchre vā bhaye vā jīvitāntage ।vimṛśan vai svayā buddhyā dhṛtimān na avasīdati ॥4-7-9॥

translations.english: 'In times of grief or loss of wealth or at the hour of death, one who is patient does not abandon his wisdom, he does not despair.
